title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
abstract: arXiv:2610.28266v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-condition

translated_title: VGL-stGen：学习肺部组织学与空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
translated_abstract: VGL-stGen 是一个多模态大语言模型，由预训练的医学视觉-语言模型适配而来，利用配对的肺部H&E（苏木精-伊红染色）图像与带有单细胞参考的空间转录组学数据进行训练。训练过程整合了图像-表达配对和表达-细胞类型配对，并通过基因条件伪标签将转录组学的细胞类型监督迁移到组织学图像上。单个部署的模型检查点即可支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测，以及基于组织学图像、细胞身份和观测基因表达组合的条件表达补全。任务特定的解码机制可生成类别标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。在条件补全任务中，固定所查询的基因身份并自回归地预测其表达水平，能够改进结构化预测。受控适配实验表明，将监督限制在所请求的表达水平token上，可以进一步提升图像条件下的生成效果。
tldr: 提出VGL-stGen，一个从预训练医学视觉-语言模型适配的多模态大语言模型，利用肺部H&E图像与空间转录组学配对数据进行训练，单个模型检查点即可支持组织/细胞类型分类、基因预测和条件表达补全等十三项任务。
en_tdlr: VGL-stGen is a multimodal LLM adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics data, supporting thirteen tasks—tissue/cell-type classification, gene prediction, and conditional expression completion—with a single deployed checkpoint.
